sources.title: Creative Economy Development Fund (CEDF) portal, Federal Ministry of Arts, Culture, Tourism and Creative Economy
sources.said: PHASE 1 Application stage Opened on 28th April and closes on 30 June, 2025. PHASE 2 Application will open on 4th August and will be targeted at SMEs and MSMEs with smaller ticket size investments.

sources.title: Federal Ministry of Information and National Orientation, 04-05-2025: Loan Opportunity for Creatives: Federal Govt Rolls Out Creative Economy Development Fund (CEDF)
sources.said: The application process will be rolled out in phases, with the first call for proposals open till May 30, 2025, prioritizing mature projects seeking over $100,000. The second phase will open on August 4, 2025, focusing on Micro Small and Medium Enterprises MSMEs and Small and Medium Enterprises SMEs requesting under $100,000. … disbursement of funds starting on January 1, 2026. For Phase Two, disbursements will start on April 1, 2026. … The Creative Economy Development Fund is structured as an independent, professionally managed investment fund, with the Ministry of Finance Incorporated serving as the anchor shareholder.

sources.title: Voice of Nigeria (state broadcaster), 25 August 2025: Nigeria Launches 2nd Phase of Creative Economy Fund
sources.said: This Phase 2 Call prioritizes proposals from businesses seeking funding of up to $100,000. The Fund is open across multiple creative sub-sectors, … including Film, Television, and Animation, Gaming, XR, and Interactive Media, Music and Entertainment, … Phase 1, which recorded thousands of applications
